note: Generated by TestTheToolRoleMatrixIsPublished (backend/internal/compose/integration). A passport on each seeded role calls every tool and action once. Each record a call names is a new one the role's user owns, made through the app's own routes; a kind the sweep cannot make is a placeholder id that names no record. A refusal counts only where the admin passes the same call. Each role whose row scope is narrower than all then calls every tool that takes a company, contact, deal, lead or project on one a colleague owns. Do not edit by hand.

reasons.conflict: The record is not in the state the call needs.
reasons.internal: The server failed, or answered 503 for a service the test stack does not start.
reasons.not_found: No such record: a kind the sweep does not seed, or a record it does not relate.
reasons.refused: The admin was refused too, so the refusal is about the record, not the role.
reasons.unsupported: The installation does not offer the service the call needs.
reasons.validation: An argument was refused: a value the filler cannot make.
